verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a dedicated Sandbox environment with test credentials, faucets for test crypto assets, and ability to 'mock flows, execute transfers and test integrations' (paxos-docs-1,4,22), which covers the general intent of rehearsing without real funds. However, there is no explicit documentation tying the sandbox to deterministic test values, nor confirmation that payouts/conversions (mint/redeem orchestrations) are specifically testable in sandbox mode rather than just payments. Missing for 10: explicit deterministic test-value behavior, sandbox coverage confirmation for conversions/payouts orchestrations, and independent/hands-on corroboration.
